Context: 1. General Provident Fund

5. Minimum and maximum subscription.(a) Should be fixed at not less than 6% of his / her emoluments on the 31st March of the preceding year and in the case of new subscribers to the emoluments on the date of joining the Fund.
- (b} The sum of the monthly subscription during a financial year together with the amount of arrear subscriptions deposited in that financial year. shall not exceed Rupees five lakhs. - GID (2), Rule 8.
